semantics.edge: All state updates on positive clk edge, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset, higher priority than ena, sets hh=0x12, mm=0, ss=0, pm=0 (12:00 AM).
semantics.enable: Each positive edge with ena=1 and reset=0 advances one second; ena=0 holds all outputs.
semantics.rollover: Seconds and minutes carry at 59. Hours advance 01 through 12 then 01. AM/PM toggles at 11:59:59 to 12:00:00; 12:59:59 to 01:00:00 preserves AM/PM, implied by a 12-hour clock.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no initial assignments; verification establishes known state through synchronous reset.

numeric.encoding: Two BCD nibbles per 8-bit time output

verification.oracle: Independent integer seconds since midnight converted to 12-hour BCD at comparisons, grounded in original clock specification.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs on falling edge and compare after rising edge NBA updates; also verify no changes before rising edge.
verification.cases: Reset with enable both low and high, enable holds, decimal carries, all hour transitions, noon and midnight over two full days, deterministic enable gaps and resets.
verification.completion: Fatal mismatch, bounded simulation timeout, explicit PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state and recovery from invalid BCD values are unspecified; neither is assigned additional behavior or required by the testbench.
